purpose: Mechanically audited Protected-Mode Ghidra contract for ARE type 0x34 and its player contact helper.

source.independent_projects: project-a and project-b decompilation/listing outputs matched

functions.name: initialize_bump_9BEE
functions.calling_convention: far ARE initializer; ES:DI is the pooled object; no caller-consumed return flags
functions.inputs_outputs: Installs callback 01F7:9C0C, performs one word ADD +0x0010 at object +0x04 and two word ADD +0x0010 operations at object +0x08, then calls 01F7:5D38 with SI=0x3568 and returns at 9C0B.
functions.scheduler_position: ARE initializer before the object is dispatched as callback 9C0C
functions.object_effects: Publishes the BUMP callback, shifts raw object words, and loads the animation descriptor selected by DS:3568.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: indirectly; callback 9C0C can call the player-state helper 1B5D

functions.name: update_bump_9C0C
functions.calling_convention: far pooled-object callback; ES:DI is the BUMP object; no caller-consumed return flags
functions.inputs_outputs: For DS:85DA < 0x32, calls 1DCA and removes the object through 1DEE when CF is set; otherwise advances the object descriptor through 5D60. It then reads AX=player X, BX=player Y, and signed CL=player +0x37 from 39FE. A qualifying strict overlap reloads DS:3568, calls 1B5D, writes DS:612E=4, and calls 01E7:0FCF.
probe_coordinates: 39FE returns player X/Y; strict object_x-0x19 < player_x < object_x+0x19
functions.scheduler_position: Pooled callback pass; under DS:85DA < 0x32, camera cull and animation advancement precede the player overlap path.
functions.object_effects: Camera cull clears object +0x18 through 1DEE; qualifying contact reloads object animation descriptor 3568 and dispatches the pending sound/effect sink 0FCF.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; 1B5D changes persistent player movement/response fields and 612E feeds the effect dispatcher

functions.name: apply_tile_transition_1B07
functions.calling_convention: far helper; resolves the persistent player through DS:881A; no caller-consumed return flags
functions.inputs_outputs: Clears DS:8950 mask bits 0x30, writes player +0x3B=0/+0x3E=0x3E8/+0x37=0xFF/+0x3A=0, copies player +0x64 to +0x0E, and calls 5D38 with SI=0x3160 when DS:8950 bit 0x4 is clear.
functions.scheduler_position: Synchronous player transition helper reached by special-tile and BUMP contact paths.
functions.object_effects: May load player animation descriptor 0x3160; no object allocation.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; writes the player mode, response, timer, and vertical velocity fields

callees.name: load_animation_descriptor
callees.flags: SI=0x3160 when DS:8950 bit 0x4 is clear

functions.name: apply_bump_player_response_1B5D
functions.calling_convention: far helper with no explicit arguments; resolves DS:881A internally; no caller-consumed return flags
functions.inputs_outputs: Calls 1B07, writes persistent player +0x2B=0xFF, then subtracts wrapping dword 0x0001B000 from persistent player +0x0E.
functions.scheduler_position: Contact response inside BUMP 9C0C after object animation reload and before DS:612E dispatch.
functions.object_effects: None directly; the nested 1B07 call can load player animation descriptor 0x3160.
functions.feeds_back_into_simulation: yes; changes the persistent player record before the next callback/player pass
